title: CobbleCove

body:
On CobbleCove, we prioritize a fun and engaging player experience. We have an active, friendly community, as well as many features like PvE Pokemon Dungeons where you can obtain loot, capture rare pokemon, and increase your wealth on the server!

We also have a completely custom leveling system, using our in-game currencies you can level up to obtain perks, buffs, and a cosmetic color, level emblem, and more. 

There's hourly raids on the hour every hour, Breeding, TMs, Bi-weekly tournaments, active discord voice-chats with our servers members, Dex rewards, Bosses, and a custom legendary spawning system!
